sourceEvidence: Simulated registers the exact block resource simulated:steering_wheel.
SteeringWheelBlock uses Y as its kinetic axis and a ceiling-mounted wheel (on_floor=false) exposes its shaft upward, matching the accepted drive cog directly above the v0.14 source coordinate.
SteeringWheelBlockEntity is a GeneratingKineticBlockEntity with exact RPM=16 and updateTargetAngle(float) produces bounded signed source rotation until its own finite angle command completes.
This probe substitutes the component source only. It does not claim cockpit routing or player/network interaction binding.
